mapper.select: SELECT mcs.id, mcs.monthly_spending_analysis_id, mcs.category_id, sc.category_code, sc.category_name, mcs.reduction_rate, mcs.baseline_spending_amount, mcs.monthly_reduction_target, mcs.monthly_usage_target, mcs.created_at, mcs.updated_at FROM mission_category_selections mcs JOIN spending_categories sc ON mcs.category_id = sc.id WHERE mcs.monthly_spending_analysis_id = #{monthlySpendingAnalysisId} ORDER BY mcs.category_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission_category_selections ( monthly_spending_analysis_id, category_id, reduction_rate, baseline_spending_amount, monthly_reduction_target, monthly_usage_target ) VALUES ( #{monthlySpendingAnalysisId}, #{categoryId}, #{reductionRate}, #{baselineSpendingAmount}, #{monthlyReductionTarget}, #{monthlyUsageTarget} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE reduction_rate = VALUES(reduction_rate), baseline_spending_amount = VALUES(baseline_spending_amount), monthly_reduction_target = VALUES(monthly_reduction_target), monthly_usage_target = VALUES(monthly_usage_target), updated_at = NOW()
